# ClarityGrid Brand Application Pack

## Choose the correct file

| Use | Recommended file |
|---|---|
| Business card, brochure or professional printer | `claritygrid-logo-print.pdf` or primary SVG |
| Word, PowerPoint, Canva or proposal | `claritygrid-logo-primary-3000.png` |
| Email header or signature | `claritygrid-logo-email-600.png` or `email-signature-template.html` |
| Website header | `claritygrid-logo-primary.svg` |
| Dark background | Reverse SVG or PNG |
| Social profile, favicon or app icon | `claritygrid-mark-1024.png` |
| One-color printing | Monochrome navy or white SVG/PNG |

## Business-card production

The front and back card files are 3.75 × 2.25 inches, including 0.125-inch bleed on every side. Final trim size is 3.5 × 2 inches. Before ordering, confirm the title, email and service-area language, then ask the printer for a proof.

## Email use

Email clients display compact images best. Use the 600-pixel email logo or the HTML signature template. The template uses the official square mark hosted on the ClarityGrid website. Keep the plain-text company name and contact information because some recipients block images.

## Print note

The supplied artwork uses the official digital colors. Ask a commercial printer to produce a physical color proof before a large print order because paper, coating and printer profiles affect color.
